name: Jenkins Automation Server Integration
description: Integration pack for Jenkins Automation Server, providing connectivity to Jenkins REST API, declarative Jenkinsfile pipeline jobs, build parameter triggers, agent node orchestration, and build status notifications.

capabilities.name: DevOps & CI/CD Engineering / Production Deployment & Release Management
capabilities.description: Integrates Jenkins build pipelines, agent nodes, parameter triggers, and SCM polling. Integrates Jenkins CD release pipelines, approval gates, and deployment artifact archiving.

checklists.name: Jenkins Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Jenkins API token credentials, webhook triggers, and node agent availability.

items.statement: Jenkins User API Token authenticates successfully against Jenkins Controller REST endpoint.
Generic Webhook Trigger plugin receives SCM commit payload and launches target pipeline job.
Jenkins Agent nodes report healthy status and required build toolchains (Node, JDK, Docker).

reviewGates.name: Jenkins Integration Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The DevOps Engineer confirms that Jenkins API tokens, webhook triggers, and agent nodes operate cleanly.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Jenkins integration verification confirm pipeline execution and build status notification?
